One of the registered icons (Eeva V1 board 2): Lucide outline, 2px stroke, round caps and joins, in the text colour of its control.

**Use:** Any icon in a design-system component or screen.

**Avoid:** An icon that is not registered here needs design sign-off first.

**Variants:** size: 12 | 13 | 14 | 15 | 16 | 18

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `IconName` | yes |  |
| `size` | `12 \| 13 \| 14 \| 15 \| 16 \| 18` | no | Sizes in use on board 2: 12 (checks in labels and chips), 13 (checks in the thinking steps), 14 (buttons, bars, toolbar), 15 (AttachMenu items, M1), 16 (header, composer), 18 (attach, folder, Drop to attach). |
| `className` | `string` | no |  |
